description: Represented audit profile for checking whether general classes of representation requests discover and route to the workflows that should handle them. Python may execute the probes and collect evidence, but the audit workflow prompt judges design implications and authors any workflow improvement suggestions.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Whether broad representation request classes have a discoverable, routing-eligible workflow path rather than depending on a one-off proper noun or source-specific path.
Whether follow-up wording such as 'this', 'that', and 'with this too' still routes to the relevant representation workflow using shared turn context.
Whether missing behaviour is best repaired in workflow, prompt, routing metadata, represented profile, or reusable support surface rather than hard-coded Python policy.
Whether proposed changes would improve a reusable class of tasks and avoid locking the system to a single incident.

avoid: Python branch tables for user-facing routing or wording
suggestions that only make the observed example pass
